reason: My bookkeeper already collects the nota every month and I almost never look at receipts myself, so this solves a problem I've handed off to someone else. I'm not putting a new bot into my site group because an ad told me to.
objection: Will this little bot still be around next year? I don't want my site expenses sitting in some tool that disappears, and then my bookkeeper has to rebuild everything.
would_change_my_mind: If my bookkeeper said she wanted it and it saved her hours. Or if it caught a real duplicate or padded nota from the supply shop that cost me money.
